太空豎琴主要由金屬舌簧組成，構成其音響的核心部件。樂器框架採用堅固的金屬結構承載: The space harp consists mainly of metal tongues, which are the core of its sound. The frame is a sturdy metal structure carrying the tongue assembly, keeping the whole instrument stable. An electric drive system of electronic components and mechanical linkage controls the vibration of the metal tongues. The resonating chamber may be wood or metal, to reinforce the sound. The internal circuitry is made of modern electronic components, which gives the instrument its electric function and combines traditional instrument materials with modern electronics.
太空豎琴亦稱法蘭克琴，屬電氣化體鳴樂器。聆聽示範可從菲爾·科蘭在太陽拉時期錄製的: The space harp, also called the frankiphone, is an electrified idiophone. A listening example can be heard on Angels and Demons at Play, recorded by Phil Cohran during his Sun Ra period; later it appears on his 1960s recordings with the Artistic Heritage Ensemble, collected on On the Beach, released in 2007. That album centres on the rhythmic and harmonic style of the space harp, with the trumpeter Don Myrick, the guitarist Pete Cosey and the studio percussionist Henry Gibson taking part.
太空豎琴以其金屬舌簧結構，發出明亮而獨特的音色。其音色具有清晰的金屬質感，帶有透: With its metal tongues the space harp produces a bright and distinctive timbre. The tone has a clear metallic quality with a thorough penetration, and the range is wide, so it can play high, soaring melodies. Its resonance is unusual: the electrically driven vibration of the metal tongues produces rich overtones, so that the timbre is crisp yet also warm. Compared with the traditional harp, the space harp's sound is more modern and more science-fictional; compared with the metallophone its timbre is softer; compared with the electronic organ it keeps more of an organic texture and of the character of physical vibration. This particular sound makes it an ideal instrument for exploring fusion music and world music.
太空豎琴為非洲體鳴舌簧琴，由 Phil Cohran 發明，作為探索其非洲根源的: The space harp is an African idiophone with tongues, invented by Phil Cohran as a musicological experiment exploring his African roots, and also called the frankiphone after his mother, Frankie. It was first recorded on Sun Ra's Angels and Demons at Play, possibly the first recording of an electric thumb piano; in the 1960s it was recorded again with The Artistic Heritage Ensemble, and On the Beach, released by Katalyst in 2007, centres on its rhythmic and harmonic style.
太空豎琴，又稱為法蘭基風琴，是由菲爾·科倫發明的電動金屬舌簧樂器，是他探索非洲根: The space harp, also called the frankiphone, is an electric metal-tongue instrument invented by Phil Cohran as part of his musicological experiment exploring his African roots. He named it after his mother, Frankie. It was first recorded during his time with Sun Ra, on the album Angels and Demons at Play. Later recordings of the space harp include his 1960s work with the Artistic Heritage Ensemble, now collected on the album On the Beach.
